messages:
mina-sales: Prospect wants a POC: EU control plane, inference inside their Canada colo, BYO-KMS (may be HSM), and no-request-egress. Need feasibility + SOW delta + quick ops checklist.

jake-eng: doable with Redwood Private + customer-managed data plane. If model weights must never leave, package runtime for onprem. Telemetry can be disabled but reduces debugability.

anya-privacy: we need exact sub-processor list and whether HSM is mandatory. If HSM required, that adds attestation and lead time. Can provide KMS flow diagrams in ~72h after confirmation.

lee-sre: network/certs: require mutual TLS between control plane (EU) and onprem agent. Proposed minimal routing:
```yaml
control_plane: eu-west1
data_plane: customer-ca-central1
failover: disabled unless signed waiver
egress_restrict: true
```
ETA: 2 days for cert rotation + runbook; +3 days if airgap packaging required.

mina-sales: ballpark SOW ask: one-time packaging, BYOK integration, monthly private fee. Numbers?

jake-eng: preliminary estimates:
- Private seat: +$6k/mo
- Onprem packaging/airgap: $25k one-time
- BYO-KMS integration: $7k (HSM add-on +$10k)
- Ops handoff & runbook: $4k
Approx first-month uplift: ~$43k (with HSM ~$53k). Recurring +$6k/mo.

anya-privacy: if they insist on "no telemetry", offer minimal heartbeat only. We'll note decreased supportability in the security response.

mina-sales: Actions: 1) @jake-eng confirm whether any metadata must live in EU control plane or can be opaque IDs (EOD). 2) @anya-privacy produce sub-processor + KMS flow (72h). 3) @lee-sre provide cert rotation plan and ops ETA (48h). I'll set a customer call once we have answers.

deploy-bot: INF-5555 created: "prospect-eu-cp-ca-onprem-byo-kms"  assignees: jake-eng, lee-sre  due: 3d.

jake-eng: noted. I'll add a signed-artifact flow for model updates to the ticket (SFTP + signed manifest).
